independent_units.reason: A problem is one unit: its folder in DSAExperimentation.LeetCode.Solutions (ARCHITECTURE §17.3) together with its <Problem>Benchmarks.cs harness (§17.7). Problems are solved independently, so a value two problems both declare, such as a board size, a digit base, a sentinel or a workload bound, is each problem's own choice and must stay free to differ. A value a problem's harness and its solution both declare is a fact about that problem, so it is still reported. Copies of the shared helpers are still reported too: LeetCode's conventions at the tier's root, a project of their own (DSAExperimentation.LeetCode) outside every unit, and the helpers beside the harnesses. Benchmarks/Fixtures is left out on purpose: a fixture can serve several problems, so its copies are still compared and argued in suppressions.json.
